name: India: the DPDP Act and Rules, ICMR guidelines, ABDM, CDSCO and CERT-In (advisory mode)
description: India: the DPDP Act and Rules, ICMR guidelines, ABDM, CDSCO and CERT-In (advisory mode). From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

frameworks.title: DPDP Act 2023 and Rules 2025, ICMR 2017 and 2023, NDCT Rules 2019, ABDM, CDSCO, CERT-In

controls.title: Notice and specific
controls.requirement: Notice and specific, informed consent for each purpose, withdrawable as easily as given.

controls.title: Processing is limited to the consented purpose
controls.requirement: Processing is limited to the consented purpose; fields are minimised.

controls.title: A processor (including a model provider) acts under a valid contract
controls.requirement: A processor (including a model provider) acts under a valid contract.

controls.title: Reasonable safeguards
controls.requirement: Reasonable safeguards, and breach notice to the Board and each person.

controls.title: Erasure when the purpose ends or consent is withdrawn
controls.requirement: Erasure when the purpose ends or consent is withdrawn, unless law requires retention.

controls.title: Verifiable parental or guardian consent where required
controls.requirement: Verifiable parental or guardian consent where required; no tracking or targeting of children.

controls.title: Significant data fiduciary duties are tracked where designated
controls.requirement: Significant data fiduciary duties are tracked where designated.

controls.title: No transfer to a country on the government's restricted list
controls.requirement: No transfer to a country on the government's restricted list.

controls.title: Use of the research exemption is recorded with its conditions
controls.requirement: Use of the research exemption is recorded with its conditions.

controls.title: The ICMR AI principles are mapped to Shio controls and ethics review is attested
controls.requirement: The ICMR AI principles are mapped to Shio controls and ethics review is attested.

controls.title: Ethics committee approval
controls.requirement: Ethics committee approval, consent, compensation and safety reporting for trials.

controls.title: ABDM consent artefacts are verified before records are used
controls.requirement: ABDM consent artefacts are verified before records are used.

controls.title: Software-as-medical-device classification and licence status are recorded
controls.requirement: Software-as-medical-device classification and licence status are recorded.

controls.title: Cyber incidents are reported within CERT-In's period
controls.requirement: Cyber incidents are reported within CERT-In's period.

controls.title: The registered practitioner stays responsible
controls.requirement: The registered practitioner stays responsible; the agent never acts as one.
